description: Land Acquisition - Alawwa, Alawwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Ellawatta, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains declarations for acquiring specific parcels of land for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, locations, and extents. The content deals exclusively with land-related administrative procedures and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the land acquisition declaration process.
